bullets: Net inflows of ₹1.74 lakh cr across all funds in October 2026, against outflows of ₹1.33 lakh cr in September.
Equity funds (active) took in ₹32,994 cr net, down 14% on the month — the lowest since Aug 26.
Most equity money went to Large & mid cap (₹8,484 cr), Small cap (₹6,407 cr), Flexi cap (₹4,980 cr).
Biggest swings: Large & mid cap +₹4,213 cr vs Sep 26; Mid cap −₹2,942 cr vs Sep 26.
Net outflows from Equity savings (−₹1,133 cr), Balanced advantage / dynamic (−₹853 cr), ELSS (tax saver) (−₹578 cr).
Debt funds: +₹1.13 lakh cr (Sep 26: −₹1.83 lakh cr), of which liquid, overnight and money market funds +₹1.27 lakh cr.
Gold ETFs +₹3,474 cr, silver ETFs +₹3,092 cr.
Investor folios rose by 15.8 lakh in the month to 28.78 crore.
28 new schemes raised ₹3,829 cr; the largest was ICICI Prudential Contra Fund (₹1,488 cr).

SIP inflows were ₹32,160 cr in October 2026 (AMFI), down 1.0% from ₹32,490 cr in September and up 8.9% on a year earlier; 50.68 lakh new SIPs against 59.12 lakh discontinued or matured (stoppage ratio 116.7%), so SIP accounts fell by 8.44 lakh to 10.80 crore; SIP assets ₹17.68 lakh cr.
Foreign portfolio investors were net sellers of ₹34,843 cr of Indian equities in October (NSDL), while equity funds took in ₹32,994 cr.

November so far: foreign portfolio investors were net buyers of ₹1.54 lakh cr of Indian equities (NSDL, to 27 Nov 2026); mutual funds were net sellers of ₹32,147 cr of equities (SEBI, to 20 Nov 2026).
Latest trading day (27 Nov 2026, exchanges, provisional): FIIs net bought ₹1,634 cr and DIIs net sold ₹556 cr in the cash market.
